changelog: Fix: the file browser could show a client's backups but list no files inside them, failing with a bare 404 (issue #20). UrBackup's per-client backup folders are mode 0750 owned by urbackup:urbackup, so St0r can only read them if its service user is in the 'urbackup' group. Its database is world-readable, so the backup list kept working while every file listing was denied — and the permission error was being reported as 'not found', which made it look like the backup was missing.

Permission failures are no longer disguised as 404s. Browsing, downloading a file, and downloading a folder now return 503 with the exact command to fix it (usermod -a -G urbackup <service user> && systemctl restart urbackup-gui) instead of a bare 'not found'.
Updates now re-assert that the service user is in the 'urbackup' group, so installs that were set up before UrBackup Server — where the installer skipped that step — repair themselves on update.

The backup storage folder is no longer silently guessed as /media/BACKUP/urbackup when /var/urbackup/backupfolder cannot be read; St0r now reports that the storage folder is not configured rather than reporting every backup as missing.
'Backup not found' now says which id was requested and that it may have been pruned, so it can be told apart from a storage access failure in the browser console.
